layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Dromaeosaur foot claw
features: Single oversized curved toe claw made of smooth yellow clay
Two smaller supporting toes tucked underneath
Blunt rounded safety tips for children
layer_3_action.action: An extreme close-up of a single upright dinosaur foot. A friendly cartoon bee is perched on the large, sickle-shaped toe claw. The foot is pointing toward a soft pink laurel flower at the edge of the frame. Focus is entirely on the unique shape of the claw. No background clutter.
